page_description: From salary to rent, severance to inflation; the calculations you need, in one place.
payroll_sub: Net take-home from gross salary and the cost to the employer.
severance_sub: Severance and notice pay based on length of service.
rent_sub: Legal maximum rent increase — 12-month CPI average (Turkish Code of Obligations art. 344).
inflation_sub: Today's purchasing power of a past amount.
loan_sub: Real cost and annual rate including interest + KKDF + BSMV.
